answer: Cross-Epoch Carryover Scoring. Each identity builds a score from its record across prior epochs; the rule compares a new epoch’s behavior against that stored history. A fresh identity cannot harbor an established track record, so each epoch it must re-earn continuity by matching its own past consistency. The system follows each identity’s behavioral thread over time, and repeated discontinuity lowers its score. Sybils face a rising cost: they must sustain consistent behavior across many epochs, and the scoring threshold follows the overall participation tide,
